title: Will Robinhood offer a qualifying tokenized U.S. stock or ETF to U.S. customers by December 31, 2026?
resolution_rules: This project-authored synthetic market resolves Yes if a U.S. Robinhood brokerage customer in at least one state can purchase a token representing a U.S. exchange-listed stock or ETF by December 31, 2026, 23:59 ET. Announcements, waitlists, tests, and unbacked price trackers do not qualify. Otherwise it resolves No.
